$comment: Generated by scripts/build-spec.mjs from the component sources — do not edit by hand.
name: Fieldset
whenToUse: Grouping related controls under one name: an address, notification settings, a section of a long form.
`disabled` on the fieldset to switch off a whole group at once.

whenNotToUse.instead: Label or the field’s own label

whenNotToUse.text: Visual grouping only, nothing to name
A group of checkboxes as one value

do.caption: One legend for related settings — read with each switch.
do.example:
<Fieldset legend="Email notifications" description="Sent to dana@seashell.dev." className="w-72">
  <Switch label="Weekly report" defaultChecked />
  <Switch label="Billing alerts" defaultChecked />
  <Switch label="Product news" />
</Fieldset>

dont.caption: A fieldset around one field: the name is said twice.

a11y: Screen readers announce the legend when focus enters the group.
Native `disabled` cascades to every control inside.
Don’t nest fieldsets more than one level — legends pile up in announcements.
